where.zh: 白天場景的配樂（〈卡在樹上的風箏〉公園・午後）
where.en: Score under daytime scenes (The Kite in the Tree, the park in the afternoon)

tracks.play: M.renderScore({len: 31, lines: [], scenes: [{t0: 0, t1: 31, tod: 'day'}]}).then((b) => { const c = M.audioCtx(), s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = b; s.connect(c.destination); s.start(c.currentTime); })

where.zh: 黃昏與夜晚場景的配樂（公園・黃昏）
where.en: Score under evening and night scenes (the park at dusk)

tracks.play: M.renderScore({len: 31, lines: [], scenes: [{t0: 0, t1: 31, tod: 'evening'}]}).then((b) => { const c = M.audioCtx(), s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = b; s.connect(c.destination); s.start(c.currentTime); })

harness.notes: js/audio.js is byte-identical to PaperPuppets' (same score generator). renderScore(T) renders the score in its own native OfflineAudioContext (22.05 kHz) and returns a Promise<AudioBuffer>, which 'play' plays through audioCtx(). DOUBT: renderer must leave window.OfflineAudioContext native and await the Promise returned by 'play' before its own render.

skipped.why: recorded voice lines (neural TTS), not music

notes: Same music as PaperPuppets (shared framework). Day = 100 bpm with bird chirps, evening = 76 bpm with crickets. If the gallery should not list duplicate songs, keep only one of the two games.
